items.title: Gucci Cuts Bag Prices 30% as Louis Vuitton Weighs Discounts
items.summary: Report on Gucci marking down items like the Padlock Crystal Small bag by roughly 30% under new CEO Luca de Meo, framed against 13 consecutive quarters of declining sales. Piece notes both Gucci and LV draw over half of revenue from middle-class shoppers whose purchasing power is deteriorating, creating a bifurcated luxury market; price-cutting is described as a strategy "long seen as a last resort."

items.title: Kering Q3 2026: Gucci revenue down 6% comparable, Asia-Pacific down 8%
items.summary: Official Kering Q3 2026 disclosure: Gucci revenue of EUR 1,291 million, down 4% reported / 6% comparable. Asia-Pacific (ex-Japan) declined 8%, with low mainland China traffic the main headwind; retail network sales down 9% comparable. Kering raised its 2026 net store-closure target to at least 125, with Asia-Pacific absorbing the largest share (42 of ~105 closures through Q3). Included as directly relevant background macro signal for the SEA/APAC demand environment even though the release predates the 72-hour window; retained because Q3 is the latest disclosed and still actively being cited this week by other outlets.

items.title: Aespa's Ningning named Gucci global brand ambassador
items.summary: Descriptive activation coverage of Gucci naming Aespa's Ningning as a global brand ambassador, part of the house's wider K-pop-forward ambassador strategy reaching Southeast Asian fan bases. Purely descriptive, no independent evaluative verdict. Retained as background context for the region's heavy ambassador-driven SNS buzz; not counted as fresh news.

items.title: PP Krit covers WWD Thailand November issue in Gucci Cruise 2027
items.summary: Thai actor PP Krit, a Gucci ambassador, fronts WWD Thailand's November cover story styled in Gucci Cruise 2027 pieces including the house's signature red-green stripe bare-top and GG-pattern bag. Coverage is admiring and descriptive (press-kit derived); no independent critical judgment offered.

items.title: Gucci Gift 2026 holiday campaign with Mariah Carey covered by Vietnamese media
items.summary: Vietnamese fashion outlet's write-up of Gucci's "Gucci Gift" holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, showcasing the Butterfly capsule and holiday accessories (GG Monogram boots, Horsebit loafers, Ace sneakers). Purely descriptive activation write-up aimed at a Vietnamese audience, no independent verdict.

items.title: Fans 'disappointed' over Mariah Carey's 'depressing' Gucci holiday campaign
items.summary: Coverage of polarized public reaction to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday campaign: critics call it "disappointing," "depressing," and "outdated," with one viewer saying the ad feels "sterile, cold, and devoid of humanity," while others defended Carey's holiday-season draw. This is third-party reporting of organic audience reaction (not brand-authored), so it carries independent evaluative weight despite being about an activation.

items.title: NINGNING x Gucci for W Korea November 2026 issue circulating on fan accounts
items.summary: K-pop fan account post sharing Aespa Ningning's Gucci-styled W Korea November 2026 editorial; circulates widely among SEA-based Aespa fan communities (fandom spans Southeast Asia heavily). Pure fan-celebratory activation amplification, no evaluative content toward the brand itself.

items.title: Vietnamese fans welcome Chi Pu at Gucci event in Thailand
items.summary: Fan-shot video clip of Vietnamese singer Chi Pu being greeted by international fans at a Gucci Primavera event in Bangkok. Older than the ideal freshness window but retained as one of the few concrete cross-border SEA fandom/SNS data points found; purely celebratory, non-evaluative toward the brand.

items.title: "Gucci reputation really had fallen jialat" - Singapore forum thread on brand image decline
items.summary: Singaporean HardwareZone forum thread (4 pages) where posters argue Gucci's prestige has eroded: complaints cite heavy discounting ("up to 50% off" at discounters), saturation of convincing counterfeits from Taobao/Shopee cheapening the brand's image, and loss of exclusivity ("too many people wearing it, no one dares buy anymore"). Posters recommend Hermes, Goyard, Faure Le Page as superior alternatives. This is organic negative community sentiment, not activation coverage. Published Jan 2026 (outside the ideal freshness window, exceeds the 14-day cap) - included in this summary's critical-angle findings but EXCLUDED from scored pool items below the dedup line due to age; retained here only as supporting evidence that critical SEA community sentiment on brand dilution/counterfeits exists historically. Flagged in coverage notes, not counted toward item totals used for index freshness.

items.title: Demna gives a lesson in sex education at Gucci Fall/Winter 2026
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Singapore runway review of Demna's Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 show: evaluative, independent critical judgment (not press-kit derived) describing the body-conscious, sexualized silhouette direction. Mixed-to-positive critical framing typical of trade-adjacent fashion criticism. Outside freshness window but the only SEA-edition independent runway critique located; retained as T2 context, not counted as a fresh daily signal.

Items 002, 003, 008, 009, 010 sit outside the 14-day cap or are background/macro context and are NOT to be treated as fresh daily buzz; they are retained only for mention-count/context completeness and explicitly flagged.
